scope.execution: Pi AI assistant under the account owner's direction
scope.interpretation: Synthetic fixtures and headless/isolated code tests, not played matches. Expected eye counts are calculated from fixture seeds, not read from visited portals. All outcomes retained; no outliers removed.

motion.additionalChecks: All ten translated-position/height cases passed an unused tenth-drop check; no human/client measurement validation.

coordinates.distribution: Uniform seed reference, not calibrated to the private Ranked filter or player route

temple.important: These conditional tests do not assert that an origin temple exists in every fixture.

provenance.note: Hashes identify retained local research artifacts. The raw logs, proprietary JARs, decompiled game code and seed-recovery executables are not distributed with this page. These are evidence summaries, not a standalone reproduction package.
